mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (1-month change < 0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% (3-month change), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer spending and housing demand, which signals an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST declines and RSAFS rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (indicated by INDPRO above 120.0), the economy is nearing capacity constraints, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 120.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales index (RSAFS) consistently indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises (1-month change > 0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (INDPRO) falls below 115.0, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 115.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) trend consistently reflects expanding manufacturing output, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises (1-month change > 0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
